 "content": "def transform(grid):
    # A lone, isolated foreign-colored pixel is recolored to the background.
    # In the examples the exceptional pixel is the sole cell in its color,
    # disconnected from all same-colored objects.
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    h,w=len(out),len(out[0])
    from collections import deque
    comps=[]; seen=set()
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if (r,c) in seen: continue
            color=out[r][c]; q=deque([(r,c)]); seen.add((r,c)); cells=[]
            while q:
                y,x=q.popleft(); cells.append((y,x))
                for yy,xx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
                    if 0<=yy<h and 0<=xx<w and (yy,xx) not in seen and out[yy][xx]==color:
                        seen.add((yy,xx)); q.append((yy,xx))
            comps.append((color,cells))
    # infer background as most frequent color
    from collections import Counter
    bg=Counter(v for row in out for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    nonbg=[(color,cells) for color,cells in comps if color!=bg]
    for color,cells in nonbg:
        if len(cells)==1:
            y,x=cells[0]
            # speck uniquely separated amidst background, unlike structured singleton fragments
            out[y][x]=bg
    return out
